decisions.choice: enroll: count and record by name
decisions.reason: The verb means to visit, inspect or muster, and in the census lists to count and register people (1:2-3, 19). The same verb means "appoint" in verse 10.

decisions.choice: every male from one month old: a count for the sanctuary, not for war
decisions.reason: The other tribes were counted from twenty years old as men able to go to war (1:3). The Levites are counted from one month, the age at which a firstborn son was bought back (18:15-16), because they are to stand in place of Israel's firstborn (verses 40-43).

decisions.choice: house of their fathers, clans: the family groups within a tribe
decisions.reason: A tribe was made up of clans, and a clan of ancestral households, each named for a forefather (1:2).

decisions.choice: enroll / count
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use "enroll", as in the census of chapter 1, and Readable "count", each time the verb is used for the census in this chapter.

decisions.choice: "tous les garçons et les hommes"
decisions.reason: Chapter 1 says "tout homme" at Balanced and Readable for men of twenty and over; here the count starts at one month (m2), so "homme" alone would leave out the baby boys. Literal keeps "tout mâle", as in chapter 1.

decisions.choice: "kila wa kiume" (L, B); "kila mvulana na mwanamume" (R)
decisions.reason: Chapter 1 says "kila mwanamume" for men of twenty and over; here the count starts at one month (m2), and "mwanamume" would suggest grown men only. "Wa kiume" covers every male, baby or man; Readable spells it out.

source.text: וַיִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צֻוָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And enrolled them Moses according to [the] mouth of Yahweh, as he had been commanded.

en.L: And Moses enrolled them at the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as he had been commanded.
en.B: So Moses enrolled them at the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as he had been commanded.
en.R: So Moses counted them, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told him to do.

es.L: Y los alistó Moisés conforme a la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como le había sido mandado.
es.B: Así que Moisés los alistó por orden {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como se le había mandado.
es.R: Así que Moisés los contó, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dicho.

fr.L: Et Moïse les recensa selon la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme il en avait reçu l’ordre.
fr.B: Moïse les recensa donc sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme cela lui avait été ordonné.
fr.R: Moïse les a donc comptés, exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le lui avait dit.

sw.L: Na Musa akawaandikisha kwa kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama alivyoamriwa.
sw.B: Basi Musa aliwaandikisha kwa agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama alivyokuwa ameamriwa.
sw.R: Basi Musa aliwahesabu, sawasawa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwambia afanye.

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of Yahweh: at the LORD's command
decisions.reason: "Mouth" stands for what someone says. Moses acts on the LORD's spoken word (verses 39, 51; 9:18).

decisions.choice: just as the LORD had told him
decisions.reason: Readable names the one who commanded, whom the Hebrew passive leaves unnamed but plain from the context.

source.text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־לֵוִ֖י בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּקְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And were these [the] sons of Levi by their names: Gershon and Kohath and Merari.

en.L: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon and Kohath and Merari.
en.B: These were the names of Levi's sons: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
en.R: Levi had three sons: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

es.L: Y estos fueron los hijos de Leví por sus nombres: Gersón, y Coat, y Merari.
es.B: Estos eran los nombres de los hijos de Leví: Gersón, Coat y Merari.
es.R: Leví tuvo tres hijos: Gersón, Coat y Merari.

fr.L: Et ce furent là les fils de Lévi selon leurs noms : Guershon, et Kehath, et Merari.
fr.B: Tels étaient les noms des fils de Lévi : Guershon, Kehath et Merari.
fr.R: Lévi avait trois fils : Guershon, Kehath et Merari.

sw.L: Na hawa walikuwa wana wa Lawi kwa majina yao: Gershoni, na Kohathi, na Merari.
sw.B: Haya ndiyo yaliyokuwa majina ya wana wa Lawi: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
sw.R: Lawi alikuwa na wana watatu: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.

decisions.choice: Gershon, Kohath and Merari: the sons of Levi
decisions.reason: The same three are listed in Genesis 46:11 and Exodus 6:16. Each gives his name to one of the three Levite groups whose work and camp are set out in verses 21-37.

source.text: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם לִבְנִ֖י וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] names of [the] sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.

en.L: And these [are] the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
en.B: The names of the sons of Gershon, by their clans, were Libni and Shimei.
en.R: Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei. Each of them was the head of a clan.

es.L: Y estos [son] los nombres de los hijos de Gersón por sus clanes: Libní y Simí.
es.B: Los nombres de los hijos de Gersón, por sus clanes, eran Libní y Simí.
es.R: Los hijos de Gersón eran Libní y Simí. Cada uno de ellos era jefe de un clan.

fr.L: Et voici les noms des fils de Guershon selon leurs clans : Libni et Shiméï.
fr.B: Les noms des fils de Guershon, selon leurs clans, étaient Libni et Shiméï.
fr.R: Les fils de Guershon étaient Libni et Shiméï. Chacun d’eux était le chef d’un clan.

sw.L: Na haya [ndiyo] majina ya wana wa Gershoni kwa koo zao: Libni na Shimei.
sw.B: Majina ya wana wa Gershoni, kwa koo zao, yalikuwa Libni na Shimei.
sw.R: Wana wa Gershoni walikuwa Libni na Shimei. Kila mmoja wao alikuwa mkuu wa ukoo.

decisions.choice: by their clans: each son is the head of a clan
decisions.reason: The phrase means the names are given as clan names. Each son's descendants form a clan (verse 21; Exodus 6:17).

decisions.choice: Each of them was the head of a clan.
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain what "by their clans" means (m1).

source.text: וּבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר חֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Kohath by their clans: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

en.L: And the sons of Kohath by their clans: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
en.B: The sons of Kohath, by their clans, were Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
en.R: Kohath's sons, the heads of his clans, were Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

es.L: Y los hijos de Coat por sus clanes: Amram e Izhar, Hebrón y Uziel.
es.B: Los hijos de Coat, por sus clanes, eran Amram, Izhar, Hebrón y Uziel.
es.R: Los hijos de Coat, jefes de sus clanes, eran Amram, Izhar, Hebrón y Uziel.

fr.L: Et les fils de Kehath selon leurs clans : Amram et Jitsehar, Hébron et Ouzziel.
fr.B: Les fils de Kehath, selon leurs clans, étaient Amram, Jitsehar, Hébron et Ouzziel.
fr.R: Les fils de Kehath, chefs de ses clans, étaient Amram, Jitsehar, Hébron et Ouzziel.

sw.L: Na wana wa Kohathi kwa koo zao: Amramu na Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
sw.B: Wana wa Kohathi, kwa koo zao, walikuwa Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
sw.R: Wana wa Kohathi, wakuu wa koo zake, walikuwa Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.

decisions.choice: Amram: the father of Moses and Aaron
decisions.reason: Amram's clan is the family of Moses and Aaron (Exodus 6:18, 20), so the priests come from the Kohathites.

source.text: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֛ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַלֵּוִ֖י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Merari by their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These [are] they, [the] clans of the Levites by [the] house of their fathers.

en.L: And the sons of Merari by their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These [are] the clans of the Levites by the house of their fathers.
en.B: The sons of Merari, by their clans, were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites by their ancestral families.
en.R: Merari's sons, the heads of his clans, were Mahli and Mushi. Those were the clans of the Levites, family by family.

es.L: Y los hijos de Merari por sus clanes: Majlí y Musí. Estos [son] los clanes de los levitas por la casa de sus padres.
es.B: Los hijos de Merari, por sus clanes, eran Majlí y Musí. Estos eran los clanes de los levitas según sus familias.
es.R: Los hijos de Merari, jefes de sus clanes, eran Majlí y Musí. Esos eran los clanes de los levitas, familia por familia.

fr.L: Et les fils de Merari selon leurs clans : Mahli et Moushi. Voilà les clans des Lévites selon la maison de leurs pères.
fr.B: Les fils de Merari, selon leurs clans, étaient Mahli et Moushi. Tels étaient les clans des Lévites selon leurs familles.
fr.R: Les fils de Merari, chefs de ses clans, étaient Mahli et Moushi. C’étaient là les clans des Lévites, famille par famille.

sw.L: Na wana wa Merari kwa koo zao: Mahli na Mushi. Hizi [ndizo] koo za Walawi kwa nyumba ya baba zao.
sw.B: Wana wa Merari, kwa koo zao, walikuwa Mahli na Mushi. Hizo ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Walawi kwa jamaa zao.
sw.R: Wana wa Merari, wakuu wa koo zake, walikuwa Mahli na Mushi. Hizo ndizo koo za Walawi, jamaa kwa jamaa.

decisions.choice: these are they: a closing summary of the list
decisions.reason: The words close the list of clans begun in verse 17. Each group is now taken in turn, with its count, its camp, its leader and its work (verses 21-37).

source.text: לְגֵ֣רְשׁ֔וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַלִּבְנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁמְעִ֑י אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֔ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: To Gershon [belonged the] clan of the Libnite[s] and [the] clan of the Shimeite[s]; these [are] they, [the] clans of the Gershonite[s].

en.L: To Gershon [belonged] the clan of the Libnites and the clan of the Shimeites; these [are] the clans of the Gershonites.
en.B: From Gershon came the clan of the Libnites and the clan of the Shimeites. These were the Gershonite clans.
en.R: The Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan came from Gershon. They were the Gershonite clans.

es.L: A Gersón [pertenecían] el clan de los libnitas y el clan de los simeítas; estos [son] los clanes de los gersonitas.
es.B: De Gersón procedían el clan de los libnitas y el clan de los simeítas. Estos eran los clanes gersonitas.
es.R: El clan libnita y el clan simeíta venían de Gersón. Eran los clanes de los gersonitas.

fr.L: À Guershon [appartenaient] le clan des Libnites et le clan des Shiméïtes ; ce [sont] là les clans des Guershonites.
fr.B: De Guershon venaient le clan des Libnites et le clan des Shiméïtes. C’étaient les clans guershonites.
fr.R: Le clan des Libnites et le clan des Shiméïtes venaient de Guershon. C’étaient les clans des Guershonites.

sw.L: Kwa Gershoni [kulikuwa na] ukoo wa Walibni na ukoo wa Washimei; hizi [ndizo] koo za Wagershoni.
sw.B: Kutoka kwa Gershoni kulitoka ukoo wa Walibni na ukoo wa Washimei. Hizo ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wagershoni.
sw.R: Koo za Walibni na za Washimei zilitoka kwa Gershoni. Hizo zilikuwa koo za Wagershoni.

decisions.choice: to Gershon: the clans descended from Gershon
decisions.reason: "To Gershon" marks what belongs to him, here the clans that come from his two sons (verse 18). The same form opens the Kohathite and Merarite sections (verses 27, 33).

decisions.choice: clan names in "-itas", lowercase: "los libnitas", "los simeítas", "los gersonitas" (and coatitas, meraritas in verses 27-35)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew forms adjectives of belonging from the clan fathers' names; Spanish forms them with "-ita", written in lowercase like other names of peoples (los levitas, los israelitas), built on the names as written in verses 17-20 (Gersón, Coat, Simí).

decisions.choice: clan names in "-ites": "les Libnites", "les Shiméïtes", "les Guershonites" (and Kehathites, Merarites in verses 27-35)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew forms adjectives of belonging from the clan fathers' names (Libnite, Shimeite, Gershonite); French forms them the same way, built on the names as written in verses 17-20, as it does for the Hittites or the Amorites.

decisions.choice: clan names with the prefix "Wa-": "Walibni", "Washimei", "Wagershoni" (and Wakohathi, Wamerari in verses 27-35)
decisions.reason: Swahili names a people or clan with the prefix "Wa-" on the founder's name, as in Walawi and Waisraeli, so each clan name is the father's name as written in verses 17-20 with "Wa-".

source.text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה פְּקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Their enrolled [men], by [the] number of every male from a son of a month and upward, their enrolled [men were] seven thousand and five hundred.

en.L: Their enrolled [men], by the number of every male from a son of a month and upward, their enrolled [men were] 7,500.
en.B: The number of those enrolled, counting every male one month old and up, was 7,500.
en.R: When they counted every boy and man at least one month old, there were 7,500.

es.L: Sus alistados, según el número de todo varón desde [la edad de] un mes en adelante, sus alistados [fueron] 7 500.
es.B: El número de alistados, contando a todo varón de un mes o más, fue de 7 500.
es.R: Al contar a todos los niños y hombres de por lo menos un mes, hubo 7 500.

fr.L: Leurs recensés, selon le nombre de tout mâle depuis [l’âge d’]un mois et au-dessus, leurs recensés [furent] 7 500.
fr.B: Le nombre des recensés, en comptant tous les garçons et les hommes d’un mois et plus, fut de 7 500.
fr.R: On a compté tous les garçons et les hommes d’au moins un mois : il y en avait 7 500.

sw.L: Walioandikishwa wao, kwa hesabu ya kila wa kiume kuanzia mwana wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, walioandikishwa wao [walikuwa] 7,500.
sw.B: Idadi ya walioandikishwa, wakihesabiwa wote wa kiume wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, ilikuwa 7,500.
sw.R: Walipohesabu wavulana na wanaume wote wa angalau mwezi mmoja, walikuwa 7,500.

decisions.choice: their enrolled, their enrolled: the subject said twice
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the subject, adds how the count was made, and names it again before the total. It is the pattern of the census lists (1:20-21).

decisions.choice: thousand: a numeral, the same word as in the census of chapter 1
decisions.reason: On the size of the numbers and the other meaning the word can have, see the note at 1:21.

source.text: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אַחֲרֵ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ יָֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] clans of the Gershonite[s] behind the tabernacle will camp, westward.

en.L: The clans of the Gershonites shall camp behind the tabernacle, westward.
en.B: The Gershonite clans were to camp behind the tabernacle, on the west side.
en.R: The Gershonite clans were to set up their tents behind the tabernacle, on the west side.

es.L: Los clanes de los gersonitas acamparán detrás del tabernáculo, hacia el occidente.
es.B: Los clanes gersonitas debían acampar detrás del tabernáculo, al lado oeste.
es.R: Los clanes de los gersonitas debían poner sus tiendas detrás del tabernáculo, al lado oeste.

fr.L: Les clans des Guershonites camperont derrière la Demeure, à l’occident.
fr.B: Les clans guershonites devaient camper derrière la Demeure, du côté ouest.
fr.R: Les clans des Guershonites devaient installer leurs tentes derrière la Demeure, du côté ouest.

sw.L: Koo za Wagershoni zitapiga kambi nyuma ya maskani, upande wa magharibi.
sw.B: Koo za Wagershoni zilipaswa kupiga kambi nyuma ya maskani, upande wa magharibi.
sw.R: Koo za Wagershoni zilitakiwa kupiga hema zao nyuma ya maskani, upande wa magharibi.

decisions.choice: behind the tabernacle, westward: the back of the tent was its west side
decisions.reason: The tabernacle faced east, toward the sunrise (verse 38; Exodus 27:13), so "behind" is west. The word for west is literally "seaward", toward the Mediterranean Sea.

decisions.choice: camp: an inner ring of Levites round the tabernacle
decisions.reason: The three Levite groups camp on three sides of the tabernacle and the priests on the fourth, between the sanctuary and the other tribes (1:53; 2:17).

decisions.choice: were to camp
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is future in form, giving the arrangement as an order. Balanced and Readable use "were to", which fits the report of the census.

source.text: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־אָ֖ב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־לָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] leader of [the] house of [the] father for the Gershonite[s was] Eliasaph son of Lael.

en.L: And the leader of the father's house of the Gershonites [was] Eliasaph son of Lael.
en.B: The leader of the ancestral family of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
en.R: The leader of the Gershonite families was Eliasaph son of Lael.

es.L: Y el jefe de la casa paterna de los gersonitas [era] Eliasaf hijo de Lael.
es.B: El jefe de la familia de los gersonitas era Eliasaf hijo de Lael.
es.R: El jefe de las familias gersonitas era Eliasaf, hijo de Lael.

fr.L: Et le chef de la maison du père des Guershonites [était] Éliasaph fils de Laël.
fr.B: Le chef de la famille des Guershonites était Éliasaph fils de Laël.
fr.R: Le chef des familles guershonites était Éliasaph, fils de Laël.

sw.L: Na kiongozi wa nyumba ya baba ya Wagershoni [alikuwa] Eliasafu mwana wa Laeli.
sw.B: Kiongozi wa jamaa ya Wagershoni alikuwa Eliasafu mwana wa Laeli.
sw.R: Kiongozi wa jamaa za Wagershoni alikuwa Eliasafu mwana wa Laeli.

decisions.choice: leader of the father's house: the chief of the whole Gershonite group
decisions.reason: Here "father's house" is used of the whole group descended from Gershon, and its leader is over all its clans (compare verses 30, 35).

source.text: וּמִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת בְּנֵֽי־גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְהָאֹ֑הֶל מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמָסַ֕ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] charge of [the] sons of Gershon in [the] tent of meeting [was] the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, and [the] screen of [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting,

en.L: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting [was] the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, and the screen of the entrance of the tent of meeting,
en.B: In the tent of meeting, the Gershonites were in charge of the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting,
en.R: At the meeting tent, the Gershonites took care of the cloth parts of the tabernacle. These were the inside curtains, the tent over them, its covers, and the curtain at the entrance of the meeting tent.

es.L: Y el encargo de los hijos de Gersón en la Tienda del Encuentro [era] el tabernáculo y la tienda, su cubierta, y la cortina de la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro,
es.B: En la Tienda del Encuentro, los gersonitas estaban a cargo del tabernáculo y de la tienda, de su cubierta, de la cortina para la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro,
es.R: En la Tienda del Encuentro, los gersonitas cuidaban las partes de tela del tabernáculo. Eran las cortinas de adentro, la tienda que iba encima, sus cubiertas y la cortina de la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et la charge des fils de Guershon dans la tente de la Rencontre [était] la Demeure et la tente, sa couverture, et le rideau de l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre,
fr.B: Dans la tente de la Rencontre, les Guershonites avaient la charge de la Demeure et de la tente, de sa couverture, du rideau de l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre,
fr.R: À la tente de la Rencontre, les Guershonites s’occupaient des parties en tissu de la Demeure : les tentures intérieures, la tente posée dessus, ses couvertures, et le rideau de l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Na ulinzi wa wana wa Gershoni katika Hema la Kukutania [ulikuwa] maskani na hema, kifuniko chake, na pazia la mlango wa Hema la Kukutania,
sw.B: Katika Hema la Kukutania, Wagershoni walikuwa na jukumu juu ya maskani na hema, kifuniko chake, pazia la mlango wa Hema la Kukutania,
sw.R: Katika Hema la Kukutania, Wagershoni walitunza sehemu za kitambaa za maskani. Hizo zilikuwa mapazia ya ndani, hema lililokuwa juu yake, vifuniko vyake, na pazia la mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: the tabernacle and the tent: the inner curtains and the tent of goats' hair over them
decisions.reason: In the building instructions, "the tabernacle" is the set of fine woven curtains and "the tent" is the cover of goats' hair spread over it (Exodus 26:1, 7). The Gershonites carry the fabric parts (4:24-26).

decisions.choice: its covering: the skins laid over the tent
decisions.reason: Ram skins dyed red and a further covering of fine leather lay on top of the tent (Exodus 26:14).

decisions.choice: the screen of the entrance: the curtain across the doorway of the tent
decisions.reason: A woven hanging closed the east entrance of the tent (Exodus 26:36). It is different from the veil before the ark.

decisions.choice: the cloth parts of the tabernacle ... inside curtains
decisions.reason: Readable explains the two technical terms of m1 so the list makes sense to a reader who does not know Exodus 26.

source.text: וְקַלְעֵ֣י הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר וְאֶת־מָסַךְ֙ פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְעַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִ֑יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתָרָ֔יו לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: and [the] hangings of the courtyard, and [the] screen of [the] entrance of the courtyard which [is] around the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords, for all its service.

en.L: and the hangings of the courtyard, and the screen of the entrance of the courtyard, which [is] around the tabernacle and the altar, and its cords, for all its service.
en.B: the hangings of the courtyard, the screen for the entrance of the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and the altar, and its cords. They did all the work connected with these things.
en.R: They also took care of the curtains around the courtyard, the curtain at the courtyard gate, and the ropes. The courtyard went around the tabernacle and the altar. The Gershonites did all the work needed for these things.

es.L: y las colgaduras del atrio, y la cortina de la entrada del atrio, que [está] alrededor del tabernáculo y del altar, y sus cuerdas, para todo su servicio.
es.B: las colgaduras del atrio, la cortina para la entrada del atrio que rodea el tabernáculo y el altar, y sus cuerdas. Ellos hacían todo el trabajo relacionado con estas cosas.
es.R: También cuidaban las colgaduras alrededor del atrio, la cortina de la puerta del atrio y las cuerdas. El atrio rodeaba el tabernáculo y el altar. Los gersonitas hacían todo el trabajo necesario para estas cosas.

fr.L: et les toiles du parvis, et le rideau de l’entrée du parvis qui [est] autour de la Demeure et de l’autel, et ses cordages, pour tout son service.
fr.B: les toiles du parvis, le rideau de l’entrée du parvis qui entoure la Demeure et l’autel, et ses cordages. Ils faisaient tout le travail lié à ces objets.
fr.R: Ils s’occupaient aussi des toiles qui entouraient le parvis, du rideau de la porte du parvis et des cordes. Le parvis entourait la Demeure et l’autel. Les Guershonites faisaient tout le travail nécessaire pour ces objets.

sw.L: na mapazia ya ua, na pazia la mlango wa ua [ulio] kandokando ya maskani na madhabahu, na kamba zake, kwa huduma yake yote.
sw.B: mapazia ya ua, pazia la mlango wa ua unaozunguka maskani na madhabahu, na kamba zake. Wao walifanya kazi yote iliyohusu vitu hivyo.
sw.R: Walitunza pia mapazia yaliyozunguka ua, pazia la lango la ua, na kamba. Ua huo ulizunguka maskani na madhabahu. Wagershoni walifanya kazi yote iliyohitajika kwa vitu hivyo.

decisions.choice: the hangings of the courtyard: the linen walls of the outer court
decisions.reason: The court around the tabernacle was fenced by linen hangings on posts (Exodus 27:9-18). The posts themselves are the Merarites' load (verse 37).

decisions.choice: which is around the tabernacle and the altar: the courtyard surrounds both
decisions.reason: The clause describes the courtyard, whose hangings enclosed the tabernacle and the altar of burnt offering in front of it.

decisions.choice: its cords, for all its service: the ropes, and all the work these things require
decisions.reason: "Its" refers back to the things listed, taken together. The Gershonites carry them, put them up and take them down (4:26).

decisions.choice: They did all the work connected with these things.
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn "for all its service" into a sentence, which closes the list that began in verse 25. Literal keeps the bare phrase.

source.text: וְלִקְהָ֗ת מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ וּמִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַיִּצְהָרִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַֽחֶבְרֹנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽעָזִּיאֵלִ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַקְּהָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And to Kohath [belonged the] clan of the Amramite[s], and [the] clan of the Izharite[s], and [the] clan of the Hebronite[s], and [the] clan of the Uzzielite[s]; these [are] they, [the] clans of the Kohathite[s].

en.L: And to Kohath [belonged] the clan of the Amramites, and the clan of the Izharites, and the clan of the Hebronites, and the clan of the Uzzielites; these [are] the clans of the Kohathites.
en.B: From Kohath came the clan of the Amramites, the clan of the Izharites, the clan of the Hebronites and the clan of the Uzzielites. These were the Kohathite clans.
en.R: The Amramite, Izharite, Hebronite and Uzzielite clans came from Kohath. They were the Kohathite clans.

es.L: Y a Coat [pertenecían] el clan de los amramitas, y el clan de los izharitas, y el clan de los hebronitas, y el clan de los uzielitas; estos [son] los clanes de los coatitas.
es.B: De Coat procedían el clan de los amramitas, el clan de los izharitas, el clan de los hebronitas y el clan de los uzielitas. Estos eran los clanes coatitas.
es.R: Los clanes amramita, izharita, hebronita y uzielita venían de Coat. Eran los clanes de los coatitas.

fr.L: Et à Kehath [appartenaient] le clan des Amramites, et le clan des Jitseharites, et le clan des Hébronites, et le clan des Ouzziélites ; ce [sont] là les clans des Kehathites.
fr.B: De Kehath venaient le clan des Amramites, le clan des Jitseharites, le clan des Hébronites et le clan des Ouzziélites. C’étaient les clans kehathites.
fr.R: Les clans des Amramites, des Jitseharites, des Hébronites et des Ouzziélites venaient de Kehath. C’étaient les clans des Kehathites.

sw.L: Na kwa Kohathi [kulikuwa na] ukoo wa Waamramu, na ukoo wa Waishari, na ukoo wa Wahebroni, na ukoo wa Wauzieli; hizi [ndizo] koo za Wakohathi.
sw.B: Kutoka kwa Kohathi kulitoka ukoo wa Waamramu, ukoo wa Waishari, ukoo wa Wahebroni na ukoo wa Wauzieli. Hizo ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wakohathi.
sw.R: Koo za Waamramu, Waishari, Wahebroni na Wauzieli zilitoka kwa Kohathi. Hizo zilikuwa koo za Wakohathi.

decisions.choice: to Kohath: the clans descended from Kohath
decisions.reason: As in verse 21. The four clans are named for the four sons of verse 19.

source.text: בְּמִסְפַּר֙ כָּל־זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שְׁמֹנַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: By [the] number of every male from a son of a month and upward, eight thousand and six hundred, keepers of [the] charge of the holy place.

en.L: By the number of every male from a son of a month and upward, [there were] 8,600, keeping the charge of the holy place.
en.B: Counting every male one month old and up, there were 8,600. They were responsible for the care of the holy place.
en.R: When they counted every boy and man at least one month old, there were 8,600. They took care of the holy things.

es.L: Según el número de todo varón desde [la edad de] un mes en adelante, [hubo] 8 600, que guardaban el encargo del lugar santo.
es.B: Contando a todo varón de un mes o más, hubo 8 600. Ellos eran responsables del cuidado del lugar santo.
es.R: Al contar a todos los niños y hombres de por lo menos un mes, hubo 8 600. Ellos cuidaban las cosas santas.

fr.L: Selon le nombre de tout mâle depuis [l’âge d’]un mois et au-dessus, [il y en eut] 8 600, qui gardaient la charge du lieu saint.
fr.B: En comptant tous les garçons et les hommes d’un mois et plus, il y en eut 8 600. Ils étaient responsables du soin du lieu saint.
fr.R: On a compté tous les garçons et les hommes d’au moins un mois : il y en avait 8 600. Ils s’occupaient des choses saintes.

sw.L: Kwa hesabu ya kila wa kiume kuanzia mwana wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, [walikuwa] 8,600, washika ulinzi wa mahali patakatifu.
sw.B: Wakihesabiwa wote wa kiume wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, walikuwa 8,600. Wao walikuwa na jukumu la kutunza mahali patakatifu.
sw.R: Walipohesabu wavulana na wanaume wote wa angalau mwezi mmoja, walikuwa 8,600. Wao walitunza vitu vitakatifu.

decisions.choice: 8,600: the number in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The three Levite totals, 7,500, 8,600 and 6,200 (verses 22, 28, 34), add up to 22,300, but verse 39 gives the whole as 22,000. One suggested explanation is a copying slip in this verse: in Hebrew "six" (shesh) and "three" (shalosh) differ by one letter, and some manuscripts of the Greek translation read 8,300 here, which would make the three groups add up to exactly 22,000. Others take 22,000 in verse 39 as a round figure. The Hebrew text is followed here; reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: keepers of the charge of the holy place: those who guard and care for the holy things
decisions.reason: "The holy place" here means the sanctuary and its most holy furniture, which the Kohathites were to carry (verse 31; 4:4-15).

decisions.choice: by the number: the census formula, without "their enrolled"
decisions.reason: This verse leaves out the words "their enrolled" that frame verse 22, but the sense is the same.

source.text: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־קְהָ֖ת יַחֲנ֑וּ עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָֽנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] clans of [the] sons of Kohath will camp on [the] side of the tabernacle, southward.

en.L: The clans of the sons of Kohath shall camp on the side of the tabernacle, southward.
en.B: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.
en.R: The Kohathite clans were to set up their tents on the south side of the tabernacle.

es.L: Los clanes de los hijos de Coat acamparán al lado del tabernáculo, hacia el sur.
es.B: Los clanes de los coatitas debían acampar al lado sur del tabernáculo.
es.R: Los clanes coatitas debían poner sus tiendas al lado sur del tabernáculo.

fr.L: Les clans des fils de Kehath camperont sur le côté de la Demeure, vers le midi.
fr.B: Les clans des Kehathites devaient camper du côté sud de la Demeure.
fr.R: Les clans des Kehathites devaient installer leurs tentes du côté sud de la Demeure.

sw.L: Koo za wana wa Kohathi zitapiga kambi upande wa maskani, kuelekea kusini.
sw.B: Koo za Wakohathi zilipaswa kupiga kambi upande wa kusini wa maskani.
sw.R: Koo za Wakohathi zilitakiwa kupiga hema zao upande wa kusini wa maskani.

decisions.choice: the side, southward: to the right of one facing east
decisions.reason: The word for south also means "right hand" (Genesis 13:9), seen from someone facing the sunrise, as the tabernacle did. The tribe of Reuben camped on the south beyond them (2:10), and Korah the Kohathite later joined Reubenites in revolt (16:1).

decisions.choice: were to camp
decisions.reason: As in verse 23.

source.text: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־אָ֖ב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י אֶלִיצָפָ֖ןבֶּן־עֻזִּיאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] leader of [the] house of [the] father of [the] clans of the Kohathite[s was] Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

en.L: And the leader of the father's house of the clans of the Kohathites [was] Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
en.B: The leader of the ancestral family of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
en.R: The leader of the Kohathite families was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

es.L: Y el jefe de la casa paterna de los clanes de los coatitas [era] Elizafán hijo de Uziel.
es.B: El jefe de la familia de los clanes coatitas era Elizafán hijo de Uziel.
es.R: El jefe de las familias coatitas era Elizafán, hijo de Uziel.

fr.L: Et le chef de la maison du père des clans des Kehathites [était] Élitsaphân fils d’Ouzziel.
fr.B: Le chef de la famille des clans kehathites était Élitsaphân fils d’Ouzziel.
fr.R: Le chef des familles kehathites était Élitsaphân, fils d’Ouzziel.

sw.L: Na kiongozi wa nyumba ya baba ya koo za Wakohathi [alikuwa] Elisafani mwana wa Uzieli.
sw.B: Kiongozi wa jamaa ya koo za Wakohathi alikuwa Elisafani mwana wa Uzieli.
sw.R: Kiongozi wa jamaa za Wakohathi alikuwa Elisafani mwana wa Uzieli.

decisions.choice: Elizaphan son of Uzziel: a cousin of Moses and Aaron
decisions.reason: Uzziel was a brother of Amram (verse 19; Exodus 6:18, 22). Elizaphan, also called Elzaphan, helped carry away the bodies of Nadab and Abihu (Leviticus 10:4).

decisions.choice: "Elizafán"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the full form of the name; the short form Elzafán is kept for Exodus 6:22 and Leviticus 10:4, where the Hebrew has it (m1).

decisions.choice: "Élitsaphân"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the full form of the name; the short form Eltsaphân is kept for Exodus 6:22 and Leviticus 10:4, where the Hebrew has it, so the reader can see the two spellings of one man (m1).

decisions.choice: "Elisafani"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the full form of the name; the short form Elsafani is kept for Exodus 6:22 and Leviticus 10:4, where the Hebrew has it (m1).

source.text: וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּ֗ם הָאָרֹ֤ן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְהַמְּנֹרָ֣ה וְהַֽמִּזְבְּחֹ֔ת וּכְלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְת֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם וְהַ֨מָּסָ֔ךְ וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And their charge [was] the ark, and the table, and the lampstand, and the altars, and [the] articles of the holy place with which they will serve, and the screen, and all its service.

en.L: And their charge [was] the ark, and the table, and the lampstand, and the altars, and the articles of the holy place with which they minister, and the screen, and all its service.
en.B: They were in charge of the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the holy utensils used in the priests' ministry, the screen, and all the work connected with these things.
en.R: They took care of the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, and the holy things used in worship. They also cared for the curtain in front of the ark. They did all the work needed for these things.

es.L: Y su encargo [era] el arca, y la mesa, y el candelabro, y los altares, y los utensilios del lugar santo con que ministran, y la cortina, y todo su servicio.
es.B: Estaban a cargo del arca, la mesa, el candelabro, los altares, los utensilios sagrados que usaban los sacerdotes en su ministerio, la cortina y todo el trabajo relacionado con estas cosas.
es.R: Cuidaban el arca, la mesa, el candelabro, los altares y los objetos santos que se usaban en el culto. También cuidaban la cortina que estaba delante del arca. Hacían todo el trabajo necesario para estas cosas.

fr.L: Et leur charge [était] l’arche, et la table, et le chandelier, et les autels, et les objets du lieu saint avec lesquels ils font le service, et le rideau, et tout son service.
fr.B: Ils avaient la charge de l’arche, de la table, du chandelier, des autels, des ustensiles sacrés utilisés par les prêtres pour leur service, du rideau, et de tout le travail lié à ces objets.
fr.R: Ils s’occupaient de l’arche, de la table, du chandelier, des autels et des objets saints qui servaient au culte. Ils s’occupaient aussi du rideau placé devant l’arche. Ils faisaient tout le travail nécessaire pour ces objets.

sw.L: Na ulinzi wao [ulikuwa] sanduku, na meza, na kinara cha taa, na madhabahu, na vyombo vya mahali patakatifu wanavyohudumu navyo, na pazia, na huduma yake yote.
sw.B: Walikuwa na jukumu juu ya sanduku, meza, kinara cha taa, madhabahu, vyombo vitakatifu vilivyotumiwa na makuhani katika huduma yao, pazia, na kazi yote iliyohusu vitu hivyo.
sw.R: Walitunza sanduku, meza, kinara cha taa, madhabahu, na vitu vitakatifu vilivyotumika katika ibada. Walitunza pia pazia lililokuwa mbele ya sanduku. Walifanya kazi yote iliyohitajika kwa vitu hivyo.

decisions.choice: the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars: the most holy furniture
decisions.reason: The ark of the testimony stood in the most holy place; the table for the bread of the presence, the lampstand and the gold altar of incense stood in the holy place, and the bronze altar of burnt offering in the courtyard (Exodus 25-27; 30:1-6). The Kohathites carried them once the priests had covered them (4:4-15).

decisions.choice: with which they minister: the vessels used in the sanctuary service
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of priests serving at the altar (Exodus 28:43). "They" refers to those who serve in the sanctuary, chiefly the priests; the Kohathites carry the vessels but do not use them in worship (4:15).

decisions.choice: the screen: here the veil before the ark
alternatives: the screen at the entrance of the tent
decisions.reason: Among the most holy things "the screen" is most likely the veil hung in front of the ark, called "the veil of the screen" in 4:5, which covered the ark on the march. The Gershonites carried the other screens (verses 25-26).

decisions.choice: used in the priests' ministry
decisions.reason: Balanced names the priests as those who use the vessels (m2).

decisions.choice: the curtain in front of the ark
decisions.reason: Readable says which screen is meant, following m3.

source.text: וּנְשִׂיא֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַלֵּוִ֔י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן פְּקֻדַּ֕ת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] leader of [the] leaders of the Levite[s was] Eleazar son of Aaron the priest; [the] oversight of [the] keepers of [the] charge of the holy place.

en.L: And the leader of the leaders of the Levites [was] Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, [with] oversight of those keeping the charge of the holy place.
en.B: The chief leader of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest. He oversaw those responsible for the care of the holy place.
en.R: Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, was the chief over all the leaders of the Levites. He was in charge of the men who took care of the holy things.

es.L: Y el jefe de los jefes de los levitas [era] Eleazar hijo de Aarón el sacerdote, [con] la supervisión de los que guardaban el encargo del lugar santo.
es.B: El jefe principal de los levitas era Eleazar hijo del sacerdote Aarón. Él supervisaba a los responsables del cuidado del lugar santo.
es.R: Eleazar, el hijo del sacerdote Aarón, era el jefe de todos los jefes de los levitas. Estaba a cargo de los hombres que cuidaban las cosas santas.

fr.L: Et le chef des chefs des Lévites [était] Éléazar fils d’Aaron le prêtre, [avec] la surveillance de ceux qui gardaient la charge du lieu saint.
fr.B: Le chef suprême des Lévites était Éléazar, fils du prêtre Aaron. Il surveillait ceux qui étaient responsables du soin du lieu saint.
fr.R: Éléazar, le fils du prêtre Aaron, était le chef de tous les chefs des Lévites. Il dirigeait les hommes qui s’occupaient des choses saintes.

sw.L: Na kiongozi wa viongozi wa Walawi [alikuwa] Eleazari mwana wa Haruni kuhani, [akiwa na] usimamizi wa washika ulinzi wa mahali patakatifu.
sw.B: Kiongozi mkuu wa Walawi alikuwa Eleazari mwana wa Haruni kuhani. Yeye aliwasimamia wale waliokuwa na jukumu la kutunza mahali patakatifu.
sw.R: Eleazari, mwana wa Haruni kuhani, alikuwa mkuu wa viongozi wote wa Walawi. Aliwasimamia watu waliotunza vitu vitakatifu.

decisions.choice: leader of the leaders: the chief leader
decisions.reason: Hebrew forms a superlative by joining a noun to its own plural, as in "holy of holies". Eleazar is over the three leaders named in verses 24, 30 and 35.

decisions.choice: the priest: Aaron, or Eleazar himself
decisions.reason: The words "the priest" can belong to Aaron, as usual in these chapters (verse 6), or to Eleazar, who is also a priest (4:16). The sense is the same either way.

decisions.choice: oversight: supervision of the work
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb translated "enroll" and "appoint" (verses 10, 15). Eleazar oversees the Kohathites in particular, and Ithamar the other two groups (4:16, 28, 33).

source.text: לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַמַּחְלִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת מְרָרִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: To Merari [belonged the] clan of the Mahlite[s] and [the] clan of the Mushite[s]; these [are] they, [the] clans of Merari.

en.L: To Merari [belonged] the clan of the Mahlites and the clan of the Mushites; these [are] the clans of Merari.
en.B: From Merari came the clan of the Mahlites and the clan of the Mushites. These were the Merarite clans.
en.R: The Mahlite clan and the Mushite clan came from Merari. They were the Merarite clans.

es.L: A Merari [pertenecían] el clan de los majlitas y el clan de los musitas; estos [son] los clanes de Merari.
es.B: De Merari procedían el clan de los majlitas y el clan de los musitas. Estos eran los clanes meraritas.
es.R: El clan majlita y el clan musita venían de Merari. Eran los clanes de los meraritas.

fr.L: À Merari [appartenaient] le clan des Mahlites et le clan des Moushites ; ce [sont] là les clans de Merari.
fr.B: De Merari venaient le clan des Mahlites et le clan des Moushites. C’étaient les clans merarites.
fr.R: Le clan des Mahlites et le clan des Moushites venaient de Merari. C’étaient les clans des Merarites.

sw.L: Kwa Merari [kulikuwa na] ukoo wa Wamahli na ukoo wa Wamushi; hizi [ndizo] koo za Merari.
sw.B: Kutoka kwa Merari kulitoka ukoo wa Wamahli na ukoo wa Wamushi. Hizo ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wamerari.
sw.R: Koo za Wamahli na za Wamushi zilitoka kwa Merari. Hizo zilikuwa koo za Wamerari.

decisions.choice: to Merari: the clans descended from Merari
decisions.reason: As in verses 21 and 27. The clans are named for the two sons of verse 20.

source.text: וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And their enrolled [men], by [the] number of every male from a son of a month and upward, [were] six thousand and two hundred.

en.L: And their enrolled [men], by the number of every male from a son of a month and upward, [were] 6,200.
en.B: The number of those enrolled, counting every male one month old and up, was 6,200.
en.R: When they counted every boy and man at least one month old, there were 6,200.

es.L: Y sus alistados, según el número de todo varón desde [la edad de] un mes en adelante, [fueron] 6 200.
es.B: El número de alistados, contando a todo varón de un mes o más, fue de 6 200.
es.R: Al contar a todos los niños y hombres de por lo menos un mes, hubo 6 200.

fr.L: Et leurs recensés, selon le nombre de tout mâle depuis [l’âge d’]un mois et au-dessus, [furent] 6 200.
fr.B: Le nombre des recensés, en comptant tous les garçons et les hommes d’un mois et plus, fut de 6 200.
fr.R: On a compté tous les garçons et les hommes d’au moins un mois : il y en avait 6 200.

sw.L: Na walioandikishwa wao, kwa hesabu ya kila wa kiume kuanzia mwana wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, [walikuwa] 6,200.
sw.B: Idadi ya walioandikishwa, wakihesabiwa wote wa kiume wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, ilikuwa 6,200.
sw.R: Walipohesabu wavulana na wanaume wote wa angalau mwezi mmoja, walikuwa 6,200.

decisions.choice: their enrolled: the census formula
decisions.reason: As in verse 22. On the total of the three groups, see the note at verse 28.

source.text: וּנְשִׂ֤יא בֵֽית־אָב֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מְרָרִ֔י צוּרִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־אֲבִיחָ֑יִל עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ צָפֹֽנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] leader of [the] house of [the] father of [the] clans of Merari [was] Zuriel son of Abihail; on [the] side of the tabernacle they will camp, northward.

en.L: And the leader of the father's house of the clans of Merari [was] Zuriel son of Abihail; they shall camp on the side of the tabernacle, northward.
en.B: The leader of the ancestral family of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail. They were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
en.R: The leader of the Merarite families was Zuriel son of Abihail. The Merarites were to set up their tents on the north side of the tabernacle.

es.L: Y el jefe de la casa paterna de los clanes de Merari [era] Zuriel hijo de Abihail; acamparán al lado del tabernáculo, hacia el norte.
es.B: El jefe de la familia de los clanes meraritas era Zuriel hijo de Abihail. Ellos debían acampar al lado norte del tabernáculo.
es.R: El jefe de las familias meraritas era Zuriel, hijo de Abihail. Los meraritas debían poner sus tiendas al lado norte del tabernáculo.

fr.L: Et le chef de la maison du père des clans de Merari [était] Tsouriel fils d’Abihaïl ; ils camperont sur le côté de la Demeure, vers le nord.
fr.B: Le chef de la famille des clans merarites était Tsouriel fils d’Abihaïl. Ils devaient camper du côté nord de la Demeure.
fr.R: Le chef des familles merarites était Tsouriel, fils d’Abihaïl. Les Merarites devaient installer leurs tentes du côté nord de la Demeure.

sw.L: Na kiongozi wa nyumba ya baba ya koo za Merari [alikuwa] Surieli mwana wa Abihaili; watapiga kambi upande wa maskani, kuelekea kaskazini.
sw.B: Kiongozi wa jamaa ya koo za Wamerari alikuwa Surieli mwana wa Abihaili. Walipaswa kupiga kambi upande wa kaskazini wa maskani.
sw.R: Kiongozi wa jamaa za Wamerari alikuwa Surieli mwana wa Abihaili. Wamerari walitakiwa kupiga hema zao upande wa kaskazini wa maskani.

decisions.choice: northward: the last side, with the east kept for the priests
decisions.reason: With the Gershonites west (verse 23), the Kohathites south (verse 29) and the Merarites north, the east side, facing the entrance, is left for Moses, Aaron and his sons (verse 38).

decisions.choice: were to camp
decisions.reason: As in verse 23.

source.text: וּפְקֻדַּ֣ת מִשְׁמֶרֶת֮ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֒ קַרְשֵׁי֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וּבְרִיחָ֖יו וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו וַאֲדָנָ֑יו וְכָל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] oversight of [the] charge of [the] sons of Merari [was the] frames of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its bases, and all its articles, and all its service,

en.L: And the oversight of the charge of the sons of Merari [was] the frames of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its bases, and all its articles, and all its service,
en.B: The Merarites were appointed to take charge of the frames of the tabernacle, its bars, posts and bases, all its equipment and all the work connected with them,
en.R: The Merarites were given the job of taking care of the wooden frames of the tabernacle. They took care of its crossbars, posts and bases, and all the tools for them. They did all the work needed for these things.

es.L: Y la supervisión del encargo de los hijos de Merari [era] los bastidores del tabernáculo, y sus travesaños, y sus columnas, y sus basas, y todos sus utensilios, y todo su servicio,
es.B: Los meraritas fueron designados para estar a cargo de los bastidores del tabernáculo, sus travesaños, postes y basas, todo su equipo y todo el trabajo relacionado con ellos,
es.R: A los meraritas se les dio el trabajo de cuidar los bastidores de madera del tabernáculo. Cuidaban sus travesaños, postes y basas, y todas las herramientas para ellos. Hacían todo el trabajo necesario para estas cosas.

fr.L: Et la surveillance de la charge des fils de Merari [était] les châssis de la Demeure, et ses traverses, et ses colonnes, et ses socles, et tous ses objets, et tout son service,
fr.B: Les Merarites furent désignés pour avoir la charge des châssis de la Demeure, de ses traverses, de ses poteaux et de ses socles, de tout son matériel et de tout le travail qui s’y rattache,
fr.R: Les Merarites ont reçu la tâche de s’occuper des châssis en bois de la Demeure. Ils s’occupaient de ses traverses, de ses poteaux et de ses socles, et de tous les outils qui allaient avec. Ils faisaient tout le travail nécessaire pour ces objets.

sw.L: Na usimamizi wa ulinzi wa wana wa Merari [ulikuwa] fremu za maskani, na mataruma yake, na nguzo zake, na misingi yake, na vyombo vyake vyote, na huduma yake yote,
sw.B: Wamerari waliwekwa kusimamia fremu za maskani, mataruma yake, nguzo na misingi yake, vifaa vyake vyote na kazi yote iliyohusu vitu hivyo,
sw.R: Wamerari walipewa kazi ya kutunza fremu za mbao za maskani. Walitunza mataruma yake, nguzo na misingi yake, na vifaa vyote vilivyohusika navyo. Walifanya kazi yote iliyohitajika kwa vitu hivyo.

decisions.choice: frames, bars, pillars, bases: the wooden framework of the tabernacle
decisions.reason: The tabernacle stood on upright frames of acacia wood set in silver bases and held together by crossbars; posts held the veil and the entrance screen (Exodus 26:15-32, 37). These heavy parts were carried on wagons (7:8).

decisions.choice: the oversight of the charge: the duty assigned to them
decisions.reason: The two nouns together mean the task given into their care (verse 32; 4:32).

decisions.choice: frames: upright wooden panels or open frames
decisions.reason: The word was once often understood as solid boards. It may describe open frames, which would be lighter to carry; either way they formed the walls of the tabernacle (Exodus 26:15-25).

decisions.choice: wooden frames
decisions.reason: Readable adds "wooden" from Exodus 26:15, so the reader can picture the frames.

source.text: וְעַמֻּדֵ֧י הֶחָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֑ם וִיתֵדֹתָ֖ם וּמֵֽיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and [the] pillars of the courtyard around, and their bases, and their pegs, and their cords.

en.L: and the pillars of the courtyard all around, and their bases, and their pegs, and their cords.
en.B: and the posts around the courtyard, with their bases, pegs and cords.
en.R: They also took care of the posts that stood around the courtyard, with their bases, tent pegs and ropes.

es.L: y las columnas del atrio alrededor, y sus basas, y sus estacas, y sus cuerdas.
es.B: y los postes alrededor del atrio, con sus basas, estacas y cuerdas.
es.R: También cuidaban los postes que estaban alrededor del atrio, con sus basas, sus estacas de tienda y sus cuerdas.

fr.L: et les colonnes du parvis tout autour, et leurs socles, et leurs piquets, et leurs cordages.
fr.B: ainsi que les poteaux tout autour du parvis, avec leurs socles, leurs piquets et leurs cordages.
fr.R: Ils s’occupaient aussi des poteaux qui se dressaient autour du parvis, avec leurs socles, leurs piquets de tente et leurs cordes.

sw.L: na nguzo za ua pande zote, na misingi yake, na vigingi vyake, na kamba zake.
sw.B: na nguzo zilizozunguka ua, pamoja na misingi yake, vigingi na kamba zake.
sw.R: Walitunza pia nguzo zilizosimama kuzunguka ua, pamoja na misingi yake, vigingi vya hema na kamba zake.

decisions.choice: the pillars of the courtyard, pegs and cords: the frame of the outer fence
decisions.reason: The courtyard hangings hung from posts standing in bronze bases, held up with pegs and ropes (Exodus 27:10-19; 35:18). The Gershonites carried the hangings, the Merarites the posts (verse 26).

decisions.choice: posts
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "posts" because "pillars" suggests stone columns; Literal keeps the usual word.

source.text: וְהַחֹנִ֣ים לִפְנֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֡ן קֵ֣דְמָה לִפְנֵי֩ אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֨ד׀מִזְרָ֜חָה מֹשֶׁ֣ה׀וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו שֹֽׁמְרִים֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּקְדָּ֔שׁ לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And those camping before the tabernacle eastward, before [the] tent of meeting toward sunrise, [were] Moses and Aaron and his sons, keeping [the] charge of the sanctuary for [the] charge of [the] sons of Israel; and the stranger who comes near will be put to death.

en.L: And those camping before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrise, [were] Moses and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel; and the outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
en.B: Those who were to camp in front of the tabernacle on the east, in front of the tent of meeting toward the sunrise, were Moses, Aaron and his sons. They were to carry out the duties of the sanctuary on behalf of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Any outsider who came near was to be put to death.
en.R: Moses, Aaron and Aaron's sons were to set up their tents on the east side, in front of the meeting tent, facing the sunrise. They were to take care of the holy tent for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Anyone else who came near the holy things had to be put to death.

es.L: Y los que acampaban delante del tabernáculo, al oriente, delante de la Tienda del Encuentro, hacia la salida del sol, [eran] Moisés y Aarón y sus hijos, que guardaban el encargo del santuario por el encargo de los hijos de Israel; y el extraño que se acerque será muerto.
es.B: Los que debían acampar delante del tabernáculo, al este, delante de la Tienda del Encuentro, hacia la salida del sol, eran Moisés, Aarón y sus hijos. Ellos debían cumplir las funciones del santuario en nombre de los israelitas. Cualquier extraño que se acercara debía ser condenado a muerte.
es.R: Moisés, Aarón y los hijos de Aarón debían poner sus tiendas al lado este, delante de la Tienda del Encuentro, mirando hacia donde sale el sol. Debían cuidar la tienda santa en favor de los israelitas. Cualquier otra persona que se acercara a las cosas santas tenía que ser ejecutada.

fr.L: Et ceux qui campaient devant la Demeure, à l’orient, devant la tente de la Rencontre, vers le lever du soleil, [étaient] Moïse et Aaron et ses fils, qui gardaient la charge du sanctuaire pour la charge des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël ; et le profane qui s’approchera sera mis à mort.
fr.B: Ceux qui devaient camper devant la Demeure, à l’est, devant la tente de la Rencontre, du côté du soleil levant, étaient Moïse, Aaron et ses fils. Ils devaient s’acquitter des fonctions du sanctuaire au nom des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Tout profane qui s’approcherait devait être mis à mort.
fr.R: Moïse, Aaron et les fils d’Aaron devaient installer leurs tentes du côté est, devant la tente de la Rencontre, face au soleil levant. Ils devaient s’occuper de la tente sainte pour les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Toute autre personne qui s’approchait des choses saintes devait être mise à mort.

sw.L: Na wale waliopiga kambi mbele ya maskani upande wa mashariki, mbele ya Hema la Kukutania kuelekea mawio ya jua, [walikuwa] Musa na Haruni na wanawe, wakishika ulinzi wa mahali patakatifu kwa ajili ya ulinzi wa wana wa Israeli; na mtu wa nje atakayekaribia atauawa.
sw.B: Wale waliopaswa kupiga kambi mbele ya maskani upande wa mashariki, mbele ya Hema la Kukutania kuelekea jua linapochomoza, walikuwa Musa, Haruni na wanawe. Walipaswa kutimiza majukumu ya mahali patakatifu kwa niaba ya Waisraeli. Mtu yeyote wa nje ambaye angekaribia alipaswa kuuawa.
sw.R: Musa, Haruni na wana wa Haruni walitakiwa kupiga hema zao upande wa mashariki, mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, kuelekea jua linapochomoza. Walitakiwa kutunza hema takatifu kwa ajili ya Waisraeli. Mtu mwingine yeyote ambaye angekaribia vitu vitakatifu ilibidi auawe.

decisions.choice: eastward, toward the sunrise: in front of the entrance
decisions.reason: The entrance of the tabernacle faced east (Exodus 27:13-16). Those camped there guarded the way in. Judah's camp lay beyond them on the same side (2:3).

decisions.choice: for the charge of the sons of Israel: on Israel's behalf
decisions.reason: The priests' care of the sanctuary is a duty done for the whole people, as the Levites' work is in verses 7-8.

decisions.choice: the outsider who comes near: anyone not authorized
decisions.reason: As in verse 10, an outsider is anyone who is not a priest who tries to do the priests' work or enter the holy places.

decisions.choice: the sanctuary: the holy place
decisions.reason: The word is built from the root "holy", and means God's holy dwelling, the tabernacle (Exodus 25:8).

decisions.choice: came near the holy things
decisions.reason: As in verse 10.

source.text: כָּל־פְּקוּדֵ֨י הַלְוִיִּ֜ם אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְׄאַׄהֲׄרֹ֛ׄןׄעַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כָּל־זָכָר֙ מִבֶּן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָמַ֔עְלָה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ס

records.literal_gloss: All [the] enrolled [men] of the Levites whom enrolled Moses and Aaron according to [the] mouth of Yahweh, by their clans, every male from a son of a month and upward, [were] two and twenty thousand.

en.L: All the enrolled [men] of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled at the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by their clans, every male from a son of a month and upward, [were] 22,000.
en.B: All the Levites enrolled by Moses and Aaron at the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, by their clans, every male one month old and up, numbered 22,000.
en.R: Moses and Aaron counted the Levites by their clans, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded. There were 22,000 boys and men at least one month old.

es.L: Todos los alistados de los levitas, que alistaron Moisés y Aarón conforme a la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, por sus clanes, todo varón desde [la edad de] un mes en adelante, [fueron] 22 000.
es.B: Todos los levitas alistados por Moisés y Aarón por orden {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, por clanes, todo varón de un mes o más, sumaron 22 000.
es.R: Moisés y Aarón contaron a los levitas por clanes, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado. Hubo 22 000 niños y hombres de por lo menos un mes.

fr.L: Tous les recensés des Lévites, que Moïse et Aaron recensèrent selon la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon leurs clans, tout mâle depuis [l’âge d’]un mois et au-dessus, [furent] 22 000.
fr.B: Tous les Lévites recensés par Moïse et Aaron sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, par clans, tous les garçons et les hommes d’un mois et plus, étaient au nombre de 22 000.
fr.R: Moïse et Aaron ont compté les Lévites par clans, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné. Il y avait 22 000 garçons et hommes d’au moins un mois.

sw.L: Walioandikishwa wote wa Walawi, ambao Musa na Haruni waliwaandikisha kwa kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa koo zao, kila wa kiume kuanzia mwana wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, [walikuwa] 22,000.
sw.B: Walawi wote walioandikishwa na Musa na Haruni kwa agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa koo zao, wote wa kiume wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, walikuwa 22,000.
sw.R: Musa na Haruni waliwahesabu Walawi kwa koo zao, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoamuru. Kulikuwa na wavulana na wanaume 22,000 wa angalau mwezi mmoja.

decisions.choice: and Aaron: marked with special dots in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew manuscripts the words "and Aaron" have dots written over them, a scribal mark that may show doubt about them. The LORD's command in verse 15 and the report in verse 16 name Moses alone, and the Samaritan Pentateuch and the Syriac translation do not have "and Aaron". The words are kept here, as in the Hebrew text. Reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: 22,000: less than the sum of the three groups
decisions.reason: Verses 22, 28 and 34 add up to 22,300. See the note at verse 28. The figure of 22,000 is the one used for the exchange with Israel's firstborn in verses 43-46.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה פְּקֹ֨ד כָּל־בְּכֹ֤ר זָכָר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה וְשָׂ֕א אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁמֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Moses, enroll every firstborn male of [the] sons of Israel from a son of a month and upward, and take [the] number of their names.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Enroll every firstborn male of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel from a son of a month and upward, and take the number of their names.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Enroll every firstborn male among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} who is one month old and up, and make a list of their names.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Count every oldest son among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} who is at least one month old. Write down their names.

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Moisés: «Alista a todo primogénito varón de los hijos de Israel desde [la edad de] un mes en adelante, y toma el número de sus nombres.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Moisés: «Alista a todos los primogénitos varones entre los israelitas, de un mes o más, y haz una lista de sus nombres.
es.R: Luego {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés: «Cuenta a todos los hijos mayores de los israelitas que tengan por lo menos un mes. Escribe sus nombres.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Recense tout premier-né mâle des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël depuis [l’âge d’]un mois et au-dessus, et relève le nombre de leurs noms.
fr.B: Puis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Recense tous les premiers-nés mâles parmi les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, âgés d’un mois et plus, et fais la liste de leurs noms.
fr.R: Ensuite {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Moïse : « Compte tous les fils aînés parmi les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} qui ont au moins un mois. Écris leurs noms.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Musa, "Umwandikishe kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa wana wa Israeli kuanzia mwana wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, na uchukue hesabu ya majina yao.
sw.B: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Musa, "Uwaandikishe wazaliwa wote wa kwanza wa kiume kati ya Waisraeli wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi, na uandike orodha ya majina yao.
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Musa, "Wahesabu wana wote wakubwa wa Waisraeli walio na angalau mwezi mmoja. Andika majina yao.

decisions.choice: every firstborn male from one month old: the sons the LORD claimed
decisions.reason: These are the firstborn sons whom the Levites replace (verses 12-13). One month is the age at which a firstborn son was to be bought back (18:16), which is why the Levites too were counted from that age (verse 15).

decisions.choice: take the number of their names: count them name by name
decisions.reason: The phrase "take the head" or "take the number" means to count, and "by names" means each person was recorded individually (1:2, 18).

decisions.choice: oldest son
decisions.reason: As in verse 12.

decisions.choice: I am Yahweh: set in the middle of the command
decisions.reason: The words break into the sentence to give the command God's authority. The Levites are taken for him, not for Moses or Aaron.

decisions.choice: the livestock of the Levites in place of the firstborn livestock
decisions.reason: Firstborn animals belonged to the LORD and were offered or bought back (Exodus 13:12-13). Here the Levites' animals as a whole are taken in exchange for the firstborn of Israel's flocks and herds at that time. Later firstborn animals were still given to the priests (18:15-18).

decisions.choice: (I [am] the LORD)

sw.R: Kulikuwa na wana wakubwa 22,273 wa angalau mwezi mmoja, waliohesabiwa kwa majina.

decisions.choice: 22,273: a small number of firstborn for so large a people
decisions.reason: Set beside 603,550 men of fighting age (1:46), 22,273 firstborn sons would mean very large families. decisions.choice: by their enrolled: as they were counted
decisions.reason: The phrase repeats the census formula: this is the total of those registered.

en.L: "Take the Levites in place of every firstborn among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock; and the Levites shall be {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

en.R: "Take the Levites in place of all the oldest sons among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Take the animals of the Levites in place of the Israelites' animals. The Levites will belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

decisions.choice: the Levites shall be mine: the exchange made final
decisions.reason: The command of verse 41 is now carried out, and the Levites belong to the LORD as the firstborn did (verses 12-13; 8:14).

decisions.choice: their livestock: the livestock of the Israelites
decisions.reason: "Their" refers back to the Israelites, whose firstborn animals are replaced (verse 41).

en.R: There are 273 more oldest sons among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} than there are Levites. They must be bought back.

sw.R: Wana wakubwa wa Waisraeli ni 273 zaidi ya idadi ya Walawi. Lazima wakombolewe.

decisions.choice: ransom: the price paid to buy back a firstborn
decisions.reason: The word is from the verb "to redeem", to set free by payment. A firstborn son belonged to the LORD and had to be bought back (Exodus 13:13-15; 34:20). Each Levite set one firstborn free; the 273 with no Levite to replace them were bought back with money.

decisions.choice: the 273: the difference between the two counts
decisions.reason: The firstborn number 22,273 (verse 43) and the Levites 22,000 (verse 39), leaving 273.

decisions.choice: There are 273 more ... They must be bought back.
decisions.reason: Readable states the difference as two sentences, where Literal and Balanced keep the sentence running into verse 47.

decisions.choice: "el rescate", "rescatar" (R "pagar el rescate")
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb "to redeem", to set free by payment (m1). Spanish "rescatar" is the verb used for the firstborn in Exodus 13:13-15 and says plainly that a price is paid; "redención" would sound abstract and theological.

decisions.choice: "le rachat", "racheter"
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb "to redeem", to set free by payment (m1). French "racheter", already used for the firstborn in Exodus 13:13-15, keeps that link; "la rançon" is kept for the payment called kofer (Exodus 21:30; 30:12).

decisions.choice: "ukombozi", "kukomboa"
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb "to redeem", to set free by payment (m1). Swahili "kukomboa" is the verb used for the firstborn in Exodus 13:13-15; "fidia" is kept for the payment called kofer (Exodus 21:30; 30:12).

decisions.choice: five, five shekels: five shekels each
decisions.reason: Saying a number twice means "so many each". "Per head" (literally "per skull") means for each person.

decisions.choice: five shekels by the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs
decisions.reason: The shekel was a weight of silver, about 11.5 grams. The sanctuary shekel was the official standard, fixed at twenty gerahs (Exodus 30:13; Leviticus 27:25). Five shekels is the price of redeeming a firstborn son (18:16) and the valuation of a boy from one month to five years (Leviticus 27:6).

decisions.choice: about 2 ounces of silver, by the sanctuary standard
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the modern weight, with the shekels and gerahs as the Measures setting; Literal keeps the units. Five shekels is about 2 ounces.

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 57 gramos de plata...|cinco siclos...}}
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable give the modern weight, with the shekels and gerahs as the Measures setting; Literal keeps the units. At the Pentateuch's value of 11.5 g a shekel, five shekels are about 57 grams.

source.text: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה הַכֶּ֔סֶף לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו פְּדוּיֵ֕י הָעֹדְפִ֖ים בָּהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will give the money to Aaron and to his sons, [the] ransom of [those who are] in excess among them.

en.L: And you shall give the money to Aaron and to his sons, the redemption of those in excess among them."
en.B: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price of the extra firstborn."
en.R: Give this money to Aaron and his sons. It is the price for buying back the extra oldest sons."

es.L: Y darás el dinero a Aarón y a sus hijos, el rescate de los que sobran entre ellos».
es.B: Da el dinero a Aarón y a sus hijos como precio del rescate de los primogénitos que sobran».
es.R: Dale este dinero a Aarón y a sus hijos. Es el precio para rescatar a los hijos mayores que sobran».

fr.L: Et tu donneras l’argent à Aaron et à ses fils, le rachat de ceux qui sont en surplus parmi eux. »
fr.B: Donne l’argent à Aaron et à ses fils comme prix du rachat des premiers-nés en surplus. »
fr.R: Donne cet argent à Aaron et à ses fils. C’est le prix pour racheter les fils aînés qui sont en trop. »

sw.L: Nawe utampa Haruni na wanawe fedha hizo, ukombozi wa wale waliozidi kati yao."
sw.B: Mpe Haruni na wanawe fedha hizo kuwa thamani ya ukombozi wa wazaliwa wa kwanza waliozidi."
sw.R: Mpe Haruni na wanawe fedha hizo. Ndiyo bei ya kuwakomboa wana wakubwa waliozidi."

decisions.choice: the money: the silver
decisions.reason: The word means silver, the metal used for payment, and so "money".

decisions.choice: to Aaron and his sons: what belongs to the LORD goes to his priests
decisions.reason: The redemption price belongs to the LORD, and he gives it to the priests (18:8, 15-16).

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף הַפִּדְי֑וֹם מֵאֵת֙ הָעֹ֣דְפִ֔ים עַ֖ל פְּדוּיֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Moses [the] money of the ransom from those in excess over [the] ransomed of the Levites.

en.L: And Moses took the money of the redemption from those in excess over those redeemed by the Levites.
en.B: So Moses collected the redemption money from those who were more than the number redeemed by the Levites.
en.R: So Moses collected the money from the families of the extra oldest sons, the ones the Levites could not replace.

es.L: Y tomó Moisés el dinero del rescate de los que sobraban respecto a los rescatados por los levitas.
es.B: Así que Moisés recogió el dinero del rescate de los que excedían el número de los rescatados por los levitas.
es.R: Así que Moisés recogió el dinero de las familias de los hijos mayores que sobraban, los que los levitas no podían reemplazar.

fr.L: Et Moïse prit l’argent du rachat de ceux qui étaient en surplus par rapport aux rachetés des Lévites.
fr.B: Moïse recueillit donc l’argent du rachat auprès de ceux qui dépassaient le nombre des premiers-nés rachetés par les Lévites.
fr.R: Moïse a donc recueilli l’argent auprès des familles des fils aînés en trop, ceux que les Lévites ne pouvaient pas remplacer.

sw.L: Na Musa akachukua fedha za ukombozi kutoka kwa wale waliozidi juu ya waliokombolewa na Walawi.
sw.B: Basi Musa alikusanya fedha za ukombozi kutoka kwa wale waliozidi idadi ya waliokombolewa na Walawi.
sw.R: Basi Musa alikusanya fedha kutoka kwa jamaa za wana wakubwa waliozidi, wale ambao Walawi hawangeweza kuchukua nafasi yao.

decisions.choice: the ransomed of the Levites: the firstborn set free by the Levites
decisions.reason: The phrase means the firstborn redeemed by being exchanged for a Levite; the money was collected only for those beyond that number.

decisions.choice: from the families of
decisions.reason: Readable says the money came from the families, since the firstborn included babies of one month.

source.text: מֵאֵ֗ת בְּכ֛וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָקַ֣ח אֶת־הַכָּ֑סֶף חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֜ים וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וָאֶ֖לֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] firstborn of [the] sons of Israel he took the money: five and sixty and three hundred and a thousand, by [the] shekel of the holy place.

en.L: From the firstborn of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel he took the money: 1,365 [shekels] by the shekel of the sanctuary.
en.B: From the firstborn of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} he collected {{units:about 34 pounds of silver by the sanctuary standard|1,365 shekels by the sanctuary shekel}}.
en.R: He collected {{units:about 34 pounds of silver, weighed by the official weight|1,365 shekels, weighed by the sanctuary shekel}} for the oldest sons of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: De los primogénitos de los hijos de Israel tomó el dinero: 1 365 [siclos] según el siclo del santuario.
es.B: De los primogénitos de los israelitas recogió {{units:unos 15,7 kilos de plata según el patrón del santuario|1 365 siclos según el siclo del santuario}}.
es.R: Recogió {{units:unos 15,7 kilos de plata, pesados según el peso oficial|1 365 siclos, pesados según el siclo del santuario}} por los hijos mayores de los israelitas.

fr.L: Des premiers-nés des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël il prit l’argent : 1 365 [sicles] selon le sicle du sanctuaire.
fr.B: Des premiers-nés des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, il recueillit {{units:environ 15,7 kilos d’argent selon l’étalon du sanctuaire|1 365 sicles selon le sicle du sanctuaire}}.
fr.R: Il a recueilli {{units:environ 15,7 kilos d’argent, pesés selon le poids officiel|1 365 sicles, pesés selon le sicle du sanctuaire}} pour les fils aînés des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Kutoka kwa wazaliwa wa kwanza wa wana wa Israeli alichukua fedha: [shekeli] 1,365 kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu.
sw.B: Kutoka kwa wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Waisraeli alikusanya {{units:karibu kilo 15.7 za fedha kwa kipimo cha mahali patakatifu|shekeli 1,365 kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu}}.
sw.R: Alikusanya {{units:karibu kilo 15.7 za fedha, zilizopimwa kwa uzito rasmi|shekeli 1,365, zilizopimwa kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu}} kwa ajili ya wana wakubwa wa Waisraeli.

decisions.choice: 1,365: five shekels for each of the 273
decisions.reason: 273 times five shekels makes 1,365 shekels (verses 46-47). The Hebrew gives the number from the smallest part up: five and sixty and three hundred and a thousand.

decisions.choice: about 34 pounds of silver
decisions.reason: 1,365 shekels at about two-fifths of an ounce each is about 34 pounds. Balanced and Readable give the modern weight with the shekels as the Measures setting; Literal keeps the shekels and supplies the unit the Hebrew leaves understood.

decisions.reason: 1,365 shekels at 11.5 g each come to about 15.7 kg, the Pentateuch's metric value; the English "34 pounds" rounds the same weight. The shekels are the Measures setting.

records.literal_gloss: And gave Moses [the] money of the ransoms to Aaron and to his sons according to [the] mouth of Yahweh, as had commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And Moses gave the money of the redemption to Aaron and to his sons at the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons at the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: Moses gave the money to Aaron and his sons, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said. He did just what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him.

es.L: Y dio Moisés el dinero del rescate a Aarón y a sus hijos conforme a la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Moisés dio el dinero del rescate a Aarón y a sus hijos por orden {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se lo había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Moisés les dio el dinero a Aarón y a sus hijos, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho. Hizo exactamente lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había mandado.

fr.L: Et Moïse donna l’argent du rachat à Aaron et à ses fils selon la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Moïse donna l’argent du rachat à Aaron et à ses fils sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Moïse a donné l’argent à Aaron et à ses fils, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait dit. Il a fait exactement ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait ordonné.

sw.L: Na Musa akawapa Haruni na wanawe fedha za ukombozi kwa kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Musa aliwapa Haruni na wanawe fedha za ukombozi kwa agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sawasawa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amemwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Musa aliwapa Haruni na wanawe fedha hizo, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema. Alifanya sawasawa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru.

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded: the chapter's closing note of obedience
decisions.reason: The two phrases together stress that Moses did exactly what he was told, as in verses 16 and 42.

decisions.choice: as the LORD had said. He did just what ...
decisions.reason: Readable splits the two phrases into two sentences so that neither is lost.
